entries.reviewFinding: CP16's heavy ion battery damage 11d10x5 ion contradicts printed p119 weapon table 3d10x5 ion. This is a source-supported transcription correction candidate; battery counts and firing arcs remain independent.

printedEvidence.observed: Heavy ion cannon battery (5 gunners): Atk +18 (-2 vs targets smaller than Colossal), Dmg 3d10x5 ion
4 heavy turbolaser, 4 turbolaser, 4 heavy ion, 2 tractor and 2 heavy concussion missile batteries
As standard action forgo all attacks: allied attacks on frigate-sized or larger targets within 2 starship squares have one greater critical damage multiplier
Endurance fleet carrier trades several batteries and consumables for two extra wings of starfighters and four point-defense laser cannon batteries

entries.reviewFinding: Two tractor beams in Ranged are an attack-group count; physical tractor hardware, station geometry and full arcs are not certified. Named Redemption medical conversion must not overwrite stock Nebulon-B.

printedEvidence.observed: 2 turbolaser batteries +14 AND 2 point-defense laser cannon batteries +14 AND 2 tractor beams +4

printedEvidence.observed: Laser cannons +6 (pilot), Dmg 5d10x2; no extra jammer attack row
Specialized jammer gives +2 equipment on attack rolls vs droid-controlled craft within five starship-scale squares
Jenta atmospheric-only six fin-guided ion bombs have -4 attack penalty and 5d10 ion field within 20 character-scale squares

entries.reviewFinding: Do not infer a second physical laser mount or import TIE Defender statistics. The multiple cockpit designs do not create separate source statblock identities.

printedEvidence.observed: Laser cannons +6 (pilot), 5d10x2; autofire option

entries.reviewFinding: Prototype maintenance and randomized benefit/drawback are template mechanics; example batteries do not establish individual hardware counts. Keep template-applied sample identity distinct from later refits.

printedEvidence.observed: 2 heavy turbolaser batteries +14, 2 light quad turbolaser batteries +14, 2 turbolaser batteries +14

entries.reviewFinding: Mk I armament 3/4/3 batteries, crew 5000 and external umbilical configuration cannot be collapsed into prototype or Mk II. Docked craft are not installed ship weapon mounts.

printedEvidence.observed: 3 light turbolaser batteries +11, 4 quad turbolaser batteries +11, 3 turbolaser batteries +11

20 external docking umbilicals: six for transports and fourteen for starfighters; cannot safely take docked ships through hyperspace
Mk I and Mk II forgo attacks as standard action and inflict -2 on enemy ship attacks within two-square radius

entries.reviewFinding: Mk II is a separate production refit. Improved 10 SR three-swift recharge is an action, not permanent or passive extra SR. Preserve variant-specific printed batteries.

printedEvidence.observed: 3 light turbolaser batteries +11 (Dmg 3d10x5), 3 quad turbolaser batteries +11, 3 turbolaser batteries +11

With three swift actions Mk II can regain 10 shield rating instead of 5
Mk I light battery deals 2d10x5 and has four quad batteries; Mk II light battery 3d10x5 and only three quad batteries

entries.reviewFinding: Sourcebook omission of hyperdrive and SR must remain typed silence, not fabricated x1, zero or borrowed later TIE specs. Singular attack family cannot fix physical arc.
